wallet.connect_body: Jikọọ akpa ego gị site na WalletConnect ma ọ bụ ngwa dabara na Stellar (LOBSTR, xBull) iji malite azụmahịa nchekwa.
wallet.awaiting_instructions:
Ngwa akpa ego gị kwesịrị emepe.
Kwetaa arịọ mbinye aka, wee laghachi ebe a.
wallet.prompt_body: Tụọ igodo ọha Stellar akpa ego gị (G…)
wallet.invalid_address_message: Biko tinye igodo ọha Stellar ziri ezi (na-amalite na G, mkpụrụedemede 56+).
wallet.no_wallet_message: Wụnye LOBSTR ma ọ bụ xBull iji bịa nka azụmahịa.
wallet.timeout_error: Njikọ akpa ego agwụla oge. Biko nwalee ọzọ.
wallet.address_mismatch: Adreesị akpa ego adabaghị. Biko jikọọ ọzọ.
wallet.invalid_response: Nzaghachi akpa ego ezighi ezi. Biko nwalee ọzọ.
wallet.verification_failed: Nyocha dara ada. Biko nwalee ọzọ.
